eli_oncall: quick heads up: automated integrity check flagged ~47 DB snapshot objects in gcs://redwood-archives/2026/03/ with missing encryption-context metadata.

marie_sre: which metadata key?

eli_oncall: encryption-context and snapshot-origin - looks like headers were omitted. Objects still SSE-CMK encrypted.

avjay_kms: ajay_kms: any KMS churn around that window?

ajay_kms: I see GenerateDataKey calls for requests between 2026-03-20T11:02-11:12Z where a short-lived grant (grant-zt12) was issued with TTL 4m. There was an auth refresh storm at ~11:08.

victor_storage: our snapshot writer does: compose stages -> finalize via ObjectCompose (GCS) which by default doesn't copy custom metadata unless explicitly merged. We recently adjusted the compose helper to reduce RPCs.

eli_oncall: timeline: flagged by daily scan at 11:30; first missing object timestamp 11:05.

marie_sre: So likely flow: data key obtained, multipart/compose started, grant expired mid-compose, agent retried with a simplified finalize that didn't merge metadata.

ajay_kms: Confirmed TTL shortness + concurrent IAM role rotation for backup-worker happened at 11:06 (role: backup-worker-v3). That could have caused ephemeral creds to bounce.

victor_storage: any quick way to list affected tenants?

eli_oncall: I pulled manifest rows: 47 objects across 12 tenants. Most manifests still have provenance json.

marie_sre: Good. Remediation plan: 1) ensure we can reapply metadata via a server-side rewrite that preserves CMEK; 2) patch writer to merge metadata during compose; 3) increase grant TTL or renew before finalize.

ajay_kms: For rewrites we need either long-lived permission for remediation service account or a KMS grant that permits ReEncrypt/Encrypt for that CMK. We can create a narrow grant for 2h per tenant.

eli_oncall: Is there any risk of double-encryption or key id mismatch if we rewrap?

ajay_kms: If we specify the same kmsKeyName during rewrite it will re-encrypt with same CMK. Must ensure the remediation principal has kms:Encrypt for that key.

victor_storage: The GCS rewrite operation can set metadata and preserve the customer-supplied encryption key if asked. We'll run a dry-run script to simulate.

marie_sre: Checklist before remediation: - confirm manifest provenance for each object - create per-tenant grant or remediation SA with scoped permissions - log all rewrites to audit storage - tag repaired objects with meta:repaired_by=encops and meta:repair_ts=...

eli_oncall: Can we do a quick query to find other compose operations that might be affected?

victor_storage: I'll run:

``
gsutil ls -L gs://redwood-archives/2026/03/** | rg "composeObject|encryption-context" -n
``

marie_sre: Also add a metric/alert: >3 finalized objects without encryption-context in 10m in a region -> page.

ajay_kms: Long-term: redesign grant flow so finalize requests renew key-grant or use a two-step ephemeral key pattern: get-data-key-with-lease, extend-lease-on-finalize.

eli_oncall: For now proceed with targeted remediation for the 47 objects. Who volunteers?

victor_storage: I'll own the rewrite script and coordinate with ajay for grant provisioning.

marie_sre: I'll run the orchestration and verify restores post-repair.

ajay_kms: I'll prepare ephemeral grants and a small automation to revoke after completion.

ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-03-GCS-META-47. Priority: P2. Links: https://internal/incidents/INC-2026-03-GCS-META-47

eli_oncall: Dry-run first, non-destructive: rewrite to same key but only apply metadata and audit tag. Post results here.

victor_storage: Dry-run results: 47 candidates, 39 reconstructable via manifest, 8 missing manifest entries (need manual recovery). Preview URL: https://internal/reports/INC-2026-03-GCS-META-47/dryrun

marie_sre: For the 8 missing: check retention logs and uploader host for transient failures. If unrecoverable, raise incident severity and prepare customer contact.

eli_oncall: Agreed. Also open PR to change compose helper to explicitly merge metadata on compose. Add unit test simulating key grant expiry mid-compose.

victor_storage: Starting dry-run rewrite (no-op mode): rewrite job id rw-5612390001-dry.

ops-bot: rewrite job rw-5612390001-dry started.

eli_oncall: Good job. Please keep this channel updated with results and any tenant escalations.

victor_storage: rw-5612390001-dry finished: 39 updated-in-dryrun, 8 flagged-manual. Will execute live rewrite in 30m after grants issued.

ajay_kms: Grants created for affected CMKs, TTL 2h. Logging grant ids to the incident log.

marie_sre: Live rewrite started. I'll validate one tenant restore after completion.

ops-bot: rewrite job rw-5612390001-live completed: 39 repaired. Audit log: https://internal/audit/rw-5612390001-live.

eli_oncall: All done. Creating follow-up tasks: patch grant TTL logic, patch compose helper, add alerts, postmortem in 72h. Thanks team.
